title: Notes Quizzer – Longer, more informative summaries on public/deployed app

requirements.summary: Render a noticeably longer, more informative summary after note upload while preserving the existing quiz behavior and ensuring the UI shows the full summary text with line breaks.
acceptanceCriteria: After uploading a document, the Summary section shows substantially more content than the current short summary (e.g., at least multiple paragraphs when source text contains multiple paragraphs).
Quiz behavior remains unchanged (still renders the existing questions and interaction behavior).
The summary UI renders the full returned summary text without cutting it off (line breaks preserved; no additional truncation in the UI beyond what the summary generator explicitly adds).

file_operations.description: Update SummaryCard to render multi-paragraph summaries more clearly (e.g., split on blank lines into multiple paragraph blocks) while preserving line breaks and avoiding any UI truncation. Continue composing existing shadcn-ui Card/Button components (do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the Summary section displays the full expanded summary returned from upload processing and does not introduce additional truncation. Keep QuizSection wiring and behavior unchanged. Use existing shadcn-ui Alert for any informational messaging if needed; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: When a webhook returns a too-short summary, generate an expanded client-side summary from the uploaded file text using the existing offline summarization logic, without altering the webhook-provided quiz array.
acceptanceCriteria: If the webhook response summary is below a defined minimum length threshold, the app extracts text from the uploaded file in the browser and generates a longer summary using the same offline summarization logic used when no webhook is configured.
If the webhook response summary is not short, the app uses the webhook-provided summary as-is.
In all cases, the quiz array shown to the user remains the webhook-provided quiz_array when a webhook is configured (no reduction in question count caused by the summary fallback).
User-facing errors remain in English and remain actionable if text extraction fails (e.g., image-only PDF).

file_operations.description: Refactor to expose summary-only capabilities (e.g., export a function that extracts text from a File and returns an offline-generated summary) so webhook flows can reuse the same offline summarization logic without regenerating/altering quiz questions. Keep current offline truncation rules intact.

Extend UploadResponse typing to support summary-fallback signaling (e.g., optional fields indicating whether an offline-expanded summary was used and/or an actionable fallback error message) without changing existing quiz item types.

Implement a minimum-length threshold check for webhook-provided summaries in uploadFile. If below threshold, extract text client-side from the uploaded file and generate an expanded summary using the exported offline summarization logic, while always keeping quiz_array from the webhook response unchanged. If extraction fails, preserve the webhook quiz_array and return an actionable English message describing why summary expansion could not be performed.

Handle new UploadResponse optional fields to inform the user when an offline summary fallback was used or when summary expansion failed. Use existing shadcn-ui Alert for actionable English messaging; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
